description: A05 natural-language recall baseline. Synthetic memories phrased the way a person states preferences, decisions, tasks and facts, with paraphrased questions. Unlike retrieval-cases.json, nothing is anchored by entity ID, so this measures lexical natural-language recall through Canonical.retrieve. Overlap is the share of the question's informative words found in the expected memory: high, partial or none.
